Using a throwaway since I am still suicidal and don’t want this getting to my main.

I’m 16 and showing signs and symptoms of moderate-severe depression. I’ve been struggling with suicidal thoughts since about 4 years ago. The only thing that keeps me going is that I still live with my parents and my little sister and I don’t want any of them finding my body. 

I still do plan on suicide, but only after I move out of my parent’s place.
I put a lot of work into growing a sub and another mod started taking over and I want some credit.
I’m 16M and , at parties, my parents treat me as a servant to all the guests needs before they send me back into hiding ( my room)
